max_records.doc: How many quest attempts one character profile may hold. A bound on a stored profile, not a game rule: the stage machine refuses an acceptance past it and the server logs the refusal. 4096 is preforged's own storage bound (gw_quest_state.h, validate).

max_credits.doc: How many objective credits one quest attempt may carry. A bound on a stored profile, not a game rule. 64 is preforged's own storage bound (gw_quest_state.h, validate); the first quest ported has no objectives.

marker_offer.doc: The 0x009F agent property 11 value that draws the offer marker above a quest giver. The client's own marker state, measured on the Town Crier before its offer (side-quests-2026-10-12 packets, tick 169041703: {11, 75, 5}). Changing it changes what this server asks the client to draw, not what the client accepts.

marker_turn_in.doc: The 0x009F agent property 11 value that draws the turn-in marker. Measured on Sir Tydus once quest 80 is accepted (tick 169042640: {11, 42, 4}). The client's own marker state, as above.

marker_none.doc: Not sent. The live server never clears a marker with property 11: it sends {12, npc, 0} (the talked-to property) to a giver whose quest was accepted and to a trainer whose turn-in was taken (four-professions-2026-10-11 packets, ticks 81485859 and 81601156), and that is what crate::quest::marker_update sends for no marker. A property-11 value of 0 is drawn by the client as a marker. Kept so the settings file still reads.
